about: Integrity manifest for Phase 1-5 FROZEN artifacts (H6 hygiene). A SHA-256 mismatch means the frozen artifact was modified and must not be committed without an approved change. Maintained by the hygiene workstream; baseline hashes recorded in reports/PHASE-6-response-interpretation-v1.md section 9. Version 2: re-baselined the live runner after the approved Phase 5 revision (CLI execution backend); all other artifact hashes were unchanged from the Phase 6 baseline. Phase 5.2: re-baselined the shipped workflow JSON and the workflow contract after correcting the Manual Trigger connection output-slot defect (single main[0] fan-out holding both read targets). Phase 5.4: re-baselined the SAME three artifacts after (a) rewiring the workflow from the diamond (Manual Trigger -> [Read Reconciliation Report, Read Response Log] -> Interpret Responses) to a strict linear chain (Manual Trigger -> Read Reconciliation Report -> Read Response Log -> Interpret Responses -> Response Interpretation Complete), and (b) extending the live runner to surface raw n8n execution errors in failure_info. The diamond is fatally unreachable under n8n pairedItem semantics — an empirical `n8n execute` run produced ExpressionError descriptionKey pairedItemNoConnectionCodeNode ("Node 'Read Reconciliation Report' hasn't been executed"). In the JSON only the connections block changed; node names, ids, types, parameters, and positions are byte-identical. The four frozen-by-task engine sources (response-interpretation.js, embedded-response-interpret.js, response-capture.js, response-reconcile.js) remain unchanged and are verified byte-identical. scripts/build-response-interpretation-workflow.js is NOT a manifest artifact and carries no revision entry. Version 3 (Phase 6.5): re-baselined the live runner after ADDITIVE harness-backend support (webhook payload injection for the test-only workflow; --inject-scenario; executeFailureInfo banner-strip via parseExecuteStdout; no behavioral change to cli/http paths) and ADDED the three Phase 6.5 test-surface artifacts to `artifacts`: the generated `Response-Interpretation V1 — Test Harness.json`, `src/response-interpretation-scenario-payloads.js`, and `src/response-interpretation-test-harness-contract.js`. All frozen hashes (e.g. the shipped workflow `ae365cd3...adb4bac`) are UNCHANGED. scripts/build-response-interpretation-test-harness.js is NOT a manifest artifact. 6.5.1 runtime revision (2026-09-14): harness-backend URL correction (harnessWebhookUrl never embeds a workflow id; dedicated RESP_INT_HARNESS_* env sourcing with N8N_BASE_URL fallback only) plus the approved single-exception empty-read continuation flag (Read Response Log alwaysOutputData=true in the harness only) re-baselined three artifacts: the live runner, the harness contract, and the generated harness JSON. The FROZEN production Response-Interpretation V1.json hash is UNCHANGED (ae365cd3b98fce08b95ccea9fae7661e4d1bde7f655326a4ed13b7031adb4bac). See reports/PHASE-6-5-REVISION-REPORT.md. Version 4 (Phase 6.6 / R-ENRICH-1): enrolled the Enrichment V1 freeze — 9 query-shape sources (enrichment-schema/cache/business/contact/contact-client/contact-oss + the three embedded node mirrors) + 3 fixture files (loader + two fixture JSON goldens), all ADDITIVE and previously-unfrozen, plus the shipped Enrichment V1.json generated deterministically by scripts/build-enrichment-workflow.js (flagged beyond the approved +11 source/fixture dilution). Enrichment V1.json is a builder-derived artifact: any hand-edit that is not reproducible by `npm run enrichment:build` breaks the freeze. No previously-frozen Phase 1-6.5 artifact sha changed. Version 5 (H.4-rev, R-ENRICH-2): AgentData is the new default contact-enrichment provider (Hunter retained, selectable). Re-implemented the client/engine/embedded-mirror around the domainSearch() -> {emails, source} / thrown-error contract; builder adds provider + agentdata* seams, a consolidating contact_provider label, and a report provider_runs key that is provider-dynamic. Re-baselined: src/enrichment-contact.js, src/enrichment-contact-client.js, src/embedded-enrichment-contact.js, fixtures/enrichment-contact-fixtures.json (hunter fixtures gained the provider label + canonical item shape; expected goldens byte-same), fixtures/enrichment-fixtures.js (AGENTDATA fixture path), and the rebuilt Enrichment V1.json; NEW frozen artifact fixtures/enrichment-contact-agentdata.json (AgentData goldens TEST-ENRICH-020/021/022/024/025/026) Version 6 (H.8c / D-C8 revision, 2026-09-18): APPROVED D-C8 country-policy change — src/enrichment-contact.js and src/enrichment-contact-oss.js gained an OPTIONAL countryInScope predicate (default isUsCountry, so the built workflow, fixtures, and every non-runner consumer are byte-behavior-identical), the live runner passes its ENRICHMENT_COUNTRIES_ALLOW/DENY policy through that seam, and Enrichment V1.json was deterministically rebuilt from the updated mirrors. ONLY these three artifact hashes changed; the two embedded-mirror source files are unchanged (they compute their composed body from the engines at load time).

Phase 5 revision: fix live runner execution mechanism - configurable execution backend (RESP_INT_EXEC_BACKEND=cli|http); cli mode spawns `docker exec -u node -e N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT=<port> <container> n8n execute --id <workflow>` with 5679 port-conflict resolution; http mode preserves the REST POST path.

Phase 5.1: contract hardening with explicit expected edges, orphan detection, unreachable-node checks, and $('Node Name') reference reachability. No behavioral changes; artifact sha changes only because the contract module is extended with canonical edge sets and reachability helpers.

Phase 5.2: correct the Manual Trigger connection output-slot defect. The old artifact listed the two read targets as main: [[a], [b]] while n8n-nodes-base.manualTrigger has exactly one output, so main[1] was silently discarded at runtime and every execution stopped at Read Response Log. Regenerated by scripts/build-response-interpretation-workflow.js with both targets living in a single main[0]. Reference: reports/PHASE-6-BLOCKER-REPORT.md. Phase 5.1's determination that the repo artifact was correct is invalid; only the connection block changed.

Phase 5.2: contract hardening for the connection output-slot defect class - enforce n8n runtime semantics so the validator fails when a connection's main array has more branches than the source node's output count, when a branch index exceeds the output count, and when an edge references an output index >= the source output count; reference topology connection layout corrected to the single-output-slot fan-out. See reports/PHASE-5-2-REPORT.md.

Phase 5.4: rewire the workflow from the diamond (Manual Trigger -> [Read Reconciliation Report, Read Response Log] -> Interpret Responses) to a strict linear chain (Manual Trigger -> Read Reconciliation Report -> Read Response Log -> Interpret Responses -> Response Interpretation Complete). An empirical `n8n execute --id` run (1 seeded row; tested on 2026-09-13) proved the diamond fatally broken: Interpret Responses threw ExpressionError descriptionKey pairedItemNoConnectionCodeNode with message "Node 'Read Reconciliation Report' hasn't been executed" — n8n pairs every input item to ONE parent item, so a sibling-branch read can never be resolved by $('...'). Zero seeded rows hid the defect (no items = no pairing check). Only the connections block changed; node names, ids, types, parameters, and positions are byte-identical. Regenerated by scripts/build-response-interpretation-workflow.js (referenceWorkflow now owns the chain; the Phase 5.2 Manual Trigger override was removed). See reports/PHASE-5-4-REPORT.md.

Phase 5.4: contract rewired to the strict linear chain. TOPOLOGY and EXPECTED_EDGES changed from the diamond fan-out to the chain; referenceWorkflow() connections emit the chain (now the single source of truth); the Phase 5.1+5.2 fan-out validation block was replaced by chain fan-in/fan-out checks (every non-terminal node exactly one outgoing edge, every non-trigger node exactly one incoming edge — the fan-in check is what catches a diamond); new pure helpers incomingCounts/outgoingCounts/pairedItemAncestors exported; assertWorkflowContract now also rejects any $('X') reference that is not a transitive pairedItem ancestor (the exact failure class: both diamond reads are reachable, yet only the item's own ancestry matters). Phase 5.1 reachability/orphan and Phase 5.2 output-slot checks retained. See reports/PHASE-5-4-REPORT.md.

Phase 5.4: runner error surfacing. Added executeFailureInfo(stdout) — a pure extractor returning the structured n8n execution error (stage:'execute', name, message, nodeCause/lastNodeExecuted from resultData.error.context; subset-only, never stack trace or runData) or { stage:'execute', name:'UnparseableOutput', message:<300-chars> } for non-empty non-JSON stdout and null for empty stdout. executeCli FAIL now attaches the structured failure so it survives into outcomes.failures -> report failure_info (fullRun and runSelectedPhases push ex.failure or fall back to the string detail); printSummary JSON-stringifies object failures; SECRET_PATTERNS extended with Bearer-token and JWT shapes so redact masks them even inside extracted error text. See reports/PHASE-5-4-REPORT.md.

Phase 6.5: ADDITIVE harness backend. executeShipped/collectExecution route through effectiveExecBackend (args.injectScenario || RESP_INT_EXEC_BACKEND=harness) to executeHarness, which POSTs buildScenarioPayload(scenario, ns) to the versioned webhook url and captures the lastNode Interpret report (normalizeHarnessResponse unwraps a single-item array; null -> NOT_CONFIGURED, non-ok/transport-throw -> FAIL, contract-gate -> FAIL). readConfig gains exec.harness.{baseUrl,workflowId,ready} (ready = baseUrl && workflowId, API key not required); buildRunReport execution block gains base_url + webhook_path; preflight adds informational harness-artifact checks under harness mode; parseArgs/usage document --inject-scenario and the harness backend. Fix: executeFailureInfo now strips n8n banner/noise lines via parseExecuteStdout before extracting the error (bare JSON path unchanged). cli/http behavior byte-identical. See reports/PHASE-6-5-REPORT.md.

Phase 6.5.1: harness backend URL/env correction. harnessWebhookUrl drops the abandoned two-segment workflow-id experiment (production mounts at /webhook/<path>, test at /webhook-test/<path>; the workflow id is NEVER part of a webhook URL). readConfig gains exec.harness.{baseUrl,workflowId,webhookPath,webhookMode,ready} sourced ONLY from dedicated RESP_INT_HARNESS_BASE_URL / RESP_INT_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_ID / RESP_INT_HARNESS_WEBHOOK_PATH / RESP_INT_HARNESS_WEBHOOK_MODE (N8N_BASE_URL fallback for baseUrl only; N8N_WORKFLOW_ID alone never satisfies the harness -> NOT_CONFIGURED). .env.example documents the harness block. Empirically, the serene_swartz container (n8n 2.38.7) registers the production webhook under a workflow-id-prefixed path (/webhook/harnessRespIntV10000001/webhook/test/resp-int-harness; the plain /webhook/test/resp-int-harness 404s even after a clean restart), so the operator MUST set RESP_INT_HARNESS_WEBHOOK_PATH to the live-registered path. See reports/PHASE-6-5-REVISION-REPORT.md.

Phase 6.5.1: approved single-exception empty-read continuation flag — the harness Read Response Log (googleSheets) node now sets alwaysOutputData=true (documented contract exception HARNESS_CONTINUATION_FLAG_NODES). A live Response Log sheet with zero data rows makes the read emit an empty branch; an empty main terminates the frozen chain and responseMode=lastNode then 500s with 'No item to return was found' (verified from n8n source webhook-last-node-response-extractor.js + decoded execution runData). The flag passes the input item through on an empty read, so the frozen Interpret Responses -> Response Interpretation Complete chain always runs and the webhook returns a structured report (empirically 200 + full report JSON after re-import + re-activate). Regenerated by scripts/build-response-interpretation-test-harness.js; the FROZEN Response-Interpretation V1.json is untouched.

Phase 6.5.1: splice-identity alwaysOutputData check is exception-aware. Read Response Log may set the documented empty-read continuation flag (alwaysOutputData=true; HARNESS_CONTINUATION_FLAG_NODES) while every other spliced node keeps the strict frozen-equal alwaysOutputData check. Module header + hygiene-rule docs describe the single allowance; +2 phase-6-5 tests (flag present on the harness node, flag on a non-exception spliced node rejected).
